message: this workflow must return a value
why: The declared return type is not void, so a bare `return;` leaves the epilogue without a value and the backend would emit a `ret` with an undefined result. A body-level `return` in a workflow is exactly the value the caller receives.
fix: return a value of the declared type
or declare the workflow's return type as void and drop the value from every other `return`
